subject: TEST RESULT: bounded presentation-time visual predictor compiles; 10/10 Kotlin checks and 1,260-case model
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-research-rd-4-visual-phase-20261002T000801Z. BASE_MAIN=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. PROTOTYPE=Android-free Fold7VisualPhasePredictorGen2 consuming upstream-accepted monotonic delivery-time angle samples only; weighted 5-sample velocity fit, freshness/residual/speed confidence, 50ms reversal guard, 32ms stale cutoff, conservative 20ms phase compensation, 36ms hard prediction horizon, physical 0..180 clamp. It owns no source/state/lease/display/handoff semantics. KOTLIN=kotlinc 1.9/JRE21 compile PASS; executable focused checks 10/10 PASS (opening/closing lead, insufficient-history fallback, stale fallback, reversal guard, noisy confidence, horizon cap, out-of-order rejection, clamp, reset isolation). MODEL=1,260 deterministic synthetic cases across 7 trajectories, 60/120Hz, delivery means 2.5/8/15ms, noise SD 0.05/0.25/0.50deg, 10 seeds, with selected 80ms dropouts. Current mathematical baseline (last delivered angle + tau28ms follower) mean case MAE=5.626deg. Conservative candidate with SAME tau28ms follower mean case MAE=2.223deg, MODELED reduction=60.5%; p95 case MAE 6.749->3.555deg; p95 of frame-P95 20.338->10.306deg. Candidate was worse in 0/1260 case-average MAE and 0/1260 frame-P95; 3/1260 abrupt 60Hz reversal cases had slightly worse single-frame max, worst +0.428deg, while their average MAE still improved. EVIDENCE_LABEL=MODEL ONLY; synthetic callback->present horizon approximated as one refresh period; no Fold7 trace, GPU timing, real Samsung jitter distribution, or topology timing. Parameters are proposal defaults for field validation, NOT production recommendations.
